name: Post
overview: The biblical use of the term 'post' primarily refers to messengers who carried official letters or decrees across the kingdoms of Israel and Judah, as well as in the Persian empire under King Ahasuerus. These posts were instrumental in delivering commands from the king and his princes, urging the people to return to God or enforcing royal decrees, sometimes involving life-or-death matters. The urgency and authority behind their mission are emphasized by their swift movement on horseback and other animals, highlighting their role as vital bearers of the king's word.
